cases.sentence: Когда Исаак состарился и глаза его так ослабли, что он ничего больше не видел, он позвал Исава, своего ___, и сказал ему:
cases.explain: «старшего сына» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

cases.sentence: Он тоже приготовил ___ и принес отцу.
cases.explain: «вкусной еды» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

cases.sentence: Ревекке передали, что сказал ее ___ Исав, и она послала за младшим сыном, Иаковом, и сказала ему:
cases.explain: «старший сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

cases.sentence: Ревекке передали, что сказал ее старший сын Исав, и она послала за ___, Иаковом, и сказала ему:
cases.explain: «младшим сыном» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
